summary: A 60-foot Blaw-Knox tower in Delaware State Forest, registered 1998; the register says in active service, but a 2017 visit saw it unstaffed and advised against climbing.

facts.design: Blaw-Knox steel tower with a 7 x 7 ft metal cab

access.note: Visit reports say do not climb: the 2017 visit found rotted steps and a boarded cab door. No posted closure found.

visit.trail_note: Directions to the tower are signed from Fire Tower Road in Milford. The 2017 visit report says not to climb it.

events.note: Earlier bald tower at the site, used circa 1917 and no longer standing

corrections.why: The register gives a 60-foot tower. The 68-foot figure appears in a map story I could not open, so the editor should confirm it before publishing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register describes the tower as in active service as a cooperative fire detection point. A 2017 visit note says it has not been staffed in a long time. The story reports both.
The register gives 60 feet. The record's 68 feet comes from a map story I could not open. The story uses the register's figure.

notes_for_editor: The record's 1935 build year is unconfirmed. The only source I found for it is an ArcGIS storymap that returned no readable text to fetch_text or WebFetch, plus an unreliable Facebook group snippet, so I left it out of events. The record's 68-foot height comes from the same storymap, while the register says 60 feet. A 2011 Pocono Record article calls it a rare Blaw-Knox, but the site returned 403. The register has a November 2024 photo but no 2024 visit text. Visit notes date to 2017 and 2021.
